Auto Model Router - Automatically select the best model based on task complexity for OpenClaw agents

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of auto-model-router for OpenClaw.

- Automatically selects the best model for each task based on complexity and type.
- Supports intelligent task classification into 8 major categories (e.g., logic reasoning, code generation, creative writing).
- Users can set up with as few as 1 model; system auto-fills remaining categories.
- Provides multiple model plans (international, domestic, and GLM “lazy” mode).
- Built-in support for sub-agent dispatch for sudden tasks and fallback on unknown input.
- Easy setup and configuration via simple commands.
